regions.merged_text: Mrs. Mary Sytek - 41 - from plains - has husband & 6 children need her - cancer - Drs. in Ann Arbor want to amputate her whole leg. They cut it open in September and it seemed to heal for a few weeks but now has broken out and more painful than ever before. Sent home from Ann Arbor as hopeless.
